significance.justification: Verified true, the claim would establish that the "consistent low-rank direction across semantically-unrelated batches" is a causal covert channel and that projecting it out suppresses trait transfer while retaining semantic distillation—a form-(ii) causal decomposition rather than a general law. It establishes both a behavioral phenomenon, selective prevention of subliminal transfer, and a mechanism separating shared steering gradients from useful example-varying gradients; this would constrain training decisions beyond the named preference tasks because Cloud et al.'s "Subliminal Learning: Language models transmit behavioral traits via hidden signals in data" reports that ordinary semantic filtering fails to prevent the transfer. Verified false would informatively reject the proposed sufficiency of low-rank cross-batch consistency as a trait-agnostic channel, although the unquantified words "suppress" and "preserving" make the boundary less sharp than a stated threshold. The topic-substitution check does not preserve this score: deleting the orthogonalization and selective causal-decomposition claims leaves only a generic extension of subliminal-learning research, which would not merit a 7.

reach.justification: The named handle is "Subliminal Immunization," specifically a training-time intervention that "projects [the consistent low-rank direction] out of the update," together with a "re-usable steering-channel diagnostic." It is ex ante because it acts during fine-tuning before a student exhibiting the transferred trait is deployed, giving distillation practitioners an action window rather than merely explaining failures afterward. After recalibration, the conclusion predicts a transferable relation—that semantically diverse batches contain a shared low-rank covert component whose removal selectively reduces trait transfer—rather than merely offering a procedure for rediscovering an arbitrary direction; the hypothesis also expressly claims single-source and trait-agnostic applicability, so likely downstream users include people training, auditing, and shipping distilled models. The topic-substitution check fails to support the same score: subliminal learning alone supplies neither this proactive handle nor its lead time, so the reach comes from the claim-specific defense.
